description: Every update lands in one pull request on Monday morning; a fix for a known vulnerability comes at once in a pull request of its own. Actions and images are pinned by digest, and a tool's checksum moves with its version.

packageRules.description: Cluster API pins the controller-runtime and Kubernetes minor it is built and tested against; those move with Cluster API, not on their own.
conversion-gen follows the Kubernetes minor go.mod builds against.

customManagers.description: A version named in a comment on the line above it: the tools the Makefile installs and the Go hack/install-go.sh installs.
The image ko builds the controller on, named by a tag that is no version, so only its digest moves.
